welcome: It's Matt & Nikki's birthday — pull up a chair, pick something cozy, and we'll bring it over. On the house; you're our guest.

items.name: Osmanthus honey iced matcha latte
items.description: Iced matcha latte with floral osmanthus honey — bright, fragrant, lightly sweet.

items.name: Earl Grey hojicha latte
items.description: Roasty hojicha meets bergamot Earl Grey over ice with milk — toasty, floral, smooth.

items.name: Earl Grey matcha latte
items.description: Iced matcha layered with bergamot-scented Earl Grey and milk — floral, toasty, mellow.

items.name: Osmanthus honey hojicha latte
items.description: Roasty hojicha with sweet osmanthus blossom over ice — nutty, fragrant, cozy.

items.name: Jalapeño and cheddar sourdough
items.description: Tangy sourdough studded with sharp cheddar and a little jalapeño kick.

items.name: Mini Focaccia sandwich
items.description: Soft mini focaccia with today's fillings — ask the hosts.

items.name: Nutella cookies
items.description: Soft, chewy cookies with gooey pockets of Nutella.

items.name: Salt Bread (Shio Pan) 塩パン
items.description: Japanese salted butter roll — crisp crust, soft crumb, buttery centre.

items.name: Nama donuts with oolong custard cream
items.description: Pillowy Japanese-style nama donuts filled with silky roasted oolong custard.

items.name: Egg tart (pastel de nata)
items.description: Flaky pastry, silky custard — classic birthday treat.

items.name: Canelé
items.description: Caramelized crust, custardy vanilla-rum centre — a little Bordeaux treat.
